name: web-anime-character-generator-hero-on-tablet-with-notched-cards-and-circular-badge
title: Anime Generator Hero on a Tablet
whatItIs: A tablet on a grainy blue-to-lilac gradient showing a lilac-grey site with a black notched header, a huge condensed caps headline 'Creation of Anime Characters', an anime illustration in a clipped-corner frame, a portrait card, a rotating circular text badge with a sparkle, an info card with a tab and social icons and a Start Free Trial pill.
whatItMeans: Clipped corners and a circular badge give a techy, graphic layout, and vivid anime art contrasts with the neutral lilac.
techniques: Clipped-corner frames and a tabbed card
Circular text badge as a decorative call to action
Vivid artwork against a muted ground

vocabulary.definition: Text set around a circle as a badge.
Fine noise added over a gradient.
